usage: evatt [-h] [--version]
             {redact,restore,verify,disclosure-record,disclosure-check} ...

Pseudonymise Australian client data in markdown, locally, before sending it.

positional arguments:
  {redact,restore,verify,disclosure-record,disclosure-check}
    redact              raw markdown to sanitised markdown
    restore             reverse the entity map over an answer
    verify              re-scan a sanitised file
    disclosure-record   record local evidence for an intended disclosure
    disclosure-check    check local evidence; does not authenticate permission

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
